text:
maya_sales: Heads up — CloudFront (enterprise) POC wants a 6-month dedicated GPU commit (equiv 6xA100) with a "surge window" that allows +2x capacity for 30m/day during peak, billed at a discounted burst rate. Need deal-desk approval for special burst carve-out and a one-time onboarding credit.

arlo_revops: Can you confirm expected base vs peak token/hour or GPU-hr? finance needs numbers to model P&L impact.

maya_sales: Rough numbers from their POC: base steady-state ~ 144 GPU-hrs/day (6xA100 sustained), peaks up to ~288 GPU-hrs/day for <1 hour across 3 time windows. So burst ~+100% but short.

sam_engineering: From infra side, autoscale + burst is fine if we reserve burst pool. Need to confirm SLOs: they'll accept degraded latency for burst (they said 200ms p95 is fine). No multi-region requirement for POC.

jeff_deals: Proposed commercial terms:
- 6 month commit: list price 6xA100 @ $14,000/mo list (example)
- Commit discount: 25% -> $10,500/mo
- Burst allowance: extra capacity up to 2x for 30m/day billed at 1.2x of commit rate when used
- One-time onboarding credit: $20k
Rationale: keep burst price > commit to protect margin but < on-demand so customer has incentive to commit.

priya_finance: Quick calc: commit revenue = $63k for 6 months. If they use bursts at 1.2x and hit full burst every day, incremental = (288-144)=144 GPU-hrs/day * 1.2x uplift -> ~we need to convert to monthly hours. Please provide GPU-hr to $ mapping per month.

maya_sales: Here's a snippet of the pricing calc I used:
```
commit_monthly = 10500
burst_multiplier = 1.2
avg_burst_hours_per_month = 144 * 30 * 0.033 # short spike ~= 30m/day across the month
estimated_burst_monthly = avg_burst_hours_per_month * (commit_monthly / (24*30)) * burst_multiplier
```
Not precise but gives ballpark. We can top-up any overage billing monthly.

arlo_revops: Two asks for approvals:
1) Revenue team sign-off on 1.2x burst multiplier (deal desk)
2) Finance sign-off on $20k onboarding credit + how to amortize for ARR recognition
Please reply with :thumbsup: if you approve or mention objections.

approvals-bot: @priya_finance requested to approve. Auto-tagging deal-desk queue.

priya_finance: I approve the onboarding credit conditional on a 30% minimum ARR recognition threshold and monthly overage reconciliation. 1.2x burst multiplier acceptable but cap daily burst charge to 3x the commit daily rate to avoid unbounded cost. :white_check_mark:

jeff_deals: I approve on behalf of sales. Will add clause: "burst usage will be billed monthly and reconciled against commit; if burst >50% of commit for 2 consecutive months, parties will re-evaluate pricing or convert to larger commit." Adds protection.

sam_engineering: Ops OK. We'll provision a dedicated burst pool and set soft throttles. Need 2-day lead time before POC start.

maya_sales: Great — I'll update the SOW with these terms and send to customer for signature. tagging @arlo_revops to add to deal desk entry.

arlo_revops: Added to deal desk with pricing notes and flagged for final legal review. Thanks all.
